Therefore, the Shaltin system must also be part of the Trans-Hydian.</ref>

The '''Shaltin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium Worlds]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] regions.<ref name="Trans-Hydian" /> The system shared its name with the [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Shaltin system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square S-6.<ref name="TEA" />
